context: While verifying real wire-release timestamps for M2 step-3 batch 1, CACI's own frozen candidate ledger entries showed two filings 1 day apart (2025-04-23, 2025-04-24) where the second is a Form 8-K/A (amendment), unlike every other candidate pair in the 66-candidate step-3 pool. Checked every one of the 66 real frozen candidates' own 'form' field directly: this is the ONLY 8-K/A among them, so it needed its own read rather than a mechanical rule.

caci_2025_04_24.amends: 0000016058-25-000043 (filed 2025-04-23, CACI's real fiscal 2025 third-quarter earnings release)
caci_2025_04_24.finding: The 8-K/A's own Explanatory Note states it exists solely to correct the Contract Awards figures in Exhibit 99.1 of the original same-topic 8-K; 'no additional changes to the press release furnished in the Original Report.' Confirmed independently at the wire level: BusinessWire's own page for the original release (businesswire.com/news/home/20250423762294) was overwritten in place the same night with a 'CORRECTING and REPLACING' version (dateline Apr 23, 2025 10:00 PM ET) -- the Wayback Machine's CDX index shows no cached snapshot of the pre-correction page survives anywhere; every capture of that URL is already the corrected version. Both the SEC-level and wire-level record agree this is a same-topic correction, not a new disclosure.
caci_2025_04_24.disposition_reason: not_a_qualifying_earnings_event: typo correction (8-K/A) to an already-counted earnings release, not an independent event. The original 2025-04-23 release (0000016058-25-000043) remains the sole real event for this disclosure and is the one built into config/m2-step3-events.json as caci-step3-2025-04-23.
caci_2025_04_24.distinct_from: This is NOT a same-day-competing-catalyst exclusion (docs/SAME-DAY-COMPETING-CATALYST-POLICY.md doesn't apply -- there is no second, different disclosure here) -- it's an event-type eligibility exclusion, same category as REKR's 2025-10-14 pre-announcement exclusion in step 2 (reports/m2-step2-eligibility-review-2026-09-28.json).
